title: Introduction to C Programming
goal: Program ka idea, C ka itihaas aur pehla C program compile karke chalana.
prereqs: Programming ka koi experience zaroori nahi
definition: C ek compiled, statically typed, procedural language hai jo 1972 me Dennis Ritchie ne Bell Labs me banayi. Aaj bhi OS, embedded devices aur databases ki backbone hai.
explain: Program instructions ki list hai: input lo, memory me rakho, calculate karo, output do. C me ye instructions .c text file me likhi jaati hain.
Compiler us text ko machine code me badalta hai, isliye C fast hai aur errors chalne se pehle milte hain — Python jaisi interpreter language me nahi.
C chhoti hai (C17 me 32 keywords) aur garbage collector nahi hai: memory aap manage karte ho. Isi discipline se OS aur drivers likhe jaate hain.
analogy: C building ka raw material hai (eent, cement, sariya); Python ready-made furniture. Raw material se ghar banana mushkil hai, par jo banaoge wahi tikta hai — aur C seekhne ke baad baaki languages ke andar ka engine samajh aata hai.
why: Pointers, memory aur performance ka asli model C se aata hai. Interviews ke pointers/segfault sawaal yahin se aate hain, aur Linux, SQLite, Redis ka source C me hai.

syntax.note: main() entry point hai; return 0 success batata hai.

topics.title: Programming kya hai
topics.body: Problem ko chhote unambiguous steps me todna. Har program me sequence, condition aur repetition hoti hai.

topics.title: C ka itihaas
topics.body: 1972 Dennis Ritchie; 1978 K&R; 1989 ANSI C; 1999 C99 (// comments, for-loop declarations); 2011 C11; 2018 C17 — aaj ka default standard.

topics.title: C ke features
topics.body: Simple core, fast code, direct memory access, portable, modular. Nahi hai: classes, GC, exceptions, built-in string type.

topics.title: Compiler vs interpreter
topics.body: Compiler poora program pehle machine code banata hai (C); interpreter line-by-line chalata hai (Python). Compiled binary tez hota hai aur bina source distribute hota hai.

topics.title: Source se executable
topics.body: .c → preprocessor → compiler → assembler (.o) → linker → executable. GCC me gcc hello.c -o hello chaaron stage ek saath karta hai.

topics.title: main(), headers, comments
topics.body: int main(void) entry point; stdio.h printf/scanf declare karti hai; // aur /* */ comments; \n, \t, \\, \" escape sequences.

examples.title: Hello World
lines: int main(void) entry point define karta hai.
printf screen par text likhta hai; \n line break.
return 0 shell ko success status deta hai.
dryRun: printf stdout buffer me likhta hai.
return par buffer flush hota hai.

examples.title: Formatted profile
lines: Format specifier aur argument order match hone chahiye.

visual.title: Source → executable
rows: Aap sirf hello.c likhte ho; baaki GCC karta hai.

mistakes.why: Bina newline shell prompt output se chipak jaata hai.
Format aur type mismatch undefined behaviour hai.
System header angle brackets se aata hai.

debug.brief: Output me Hello aur World ek hi line me chipak rahe hain. Fix karo.

best: Ek program me ek hi main()

practice.title: Naam print
practice.prompt: Naam, city aur goal teen alag lines me print karo.

practice.title: Sum sentence
practice.prompt: Do integers ka sum ek sentence me print karo.

mcqs.explain: C17 = ISO/IEC 9899:2018, C11 ka bug-fix release.
stdio.h standard I/O declarations deti hai.

interview.q: C ko middle-level language kyun kehte hain?
interview.a: High-level syntax aur low-level memory access (pointers, bitwise ops) dono deta hai, isliye OS aur embedded dono me use hota hai.
interview.followUp: Hardware ke sabse kareeb cheez? — pointers aur volatile.

interview.a: Compiler pehle poora machine code banata hai, interpreter line-by-line chalta hai. C me errors runtime se pehle milte hain aur execution fast hoti hai.
interview.followUp: C runtime error example? — divide by zero, null dereference.

interview.q: main() ka return value kahan jaata hai?
interview.a: OS ko exit status ke roop me: 0 success, non-zero failure. Shell me echo $? se dikhta hai.
